zone.title: Am I in an evacuation zone?
zone.body: Check a location against tsunami evacuation zones. This works offline.
zone.naturalWarningSource: Source: National Weather Service tsunami safety guidance

places.title: Hurricane refuge areas
places.body: The closest official hurricane refuge areas on Oʻahu, by straight-line distance. This works offline.
places.outsideCoverage: We only have refuge area data for Oʻahu.

alerts.title: Weather alerts
alerts.body: Alerts for Hawaiʻi from the National Weather Service. The last copy stays on your phone, so you can still read it with no signal.

plan.title: Family emergency plan
plan.body: Write down where your household will meet and who to call. Everything stays on this phone.

safety.naturalWarning: If you feel a strong earthquake or see the ocean suddenly pull back, move inland or to high ground right away. Do not wait for an official warning.
safety.inZone: If any tsunami warning is issued, leave this zone right away. Go inland or to high ground, on foot if you can.
safety.notInZone: Being outside a mapped zone does not guarantee you are safe. Always follow instructions from emergency officials.
safety.placesDisclaimer: Distances are straight-line, not driving or walking routes. Not every refuge area opens in an emergency, so check official announcements before you go.
safety.inZoneHeading: You are in a tsunami evacuation zone
safety.inExtremeHeading: You are in an extreme tsunami evacuation zone
safety.inExtremeZone: Leave this zone right away if an Extreme Tsunami Warning is issued, or if officials tell you to. Go inland or to high ground, on foot if you can.
safety.notInZoneHeading: You are outside the mapped tsunami evacuation zones
safety.outsideCoverageHeading: This location is outside the area our zone data covers, so we can't tell you.
safety.alertsStale: These alerts may be out of date. For the latest, listen to local radio or TV, or NOAA Weather Radio.
safety.kitWater: Water: {{gallons}} gallons (1 gallon per person per day for {{days}} days)
safety.kitFood: Food that keeps without a fridge, enough for {{days}} days
safety.kitMeds: Medicines and copies of prescriptions for {{days}} days
safety.kitPower: Phone chargers and a charged backup battery
safety.kitDocs: Copies of IDs, insurance, and important papers in a waterproof bag
safety.kitPets: Food, water, and supplies for pets
safety.kitKnowZone: Check whether your home, school, and work are in a tsunami evacuation zone
safety.kitOutOfArea: Pick an off-island contact everyone in the household can call
safety.printPlan: Print a copy and keep it with your kit. Phones can run out of battery.
safety.refugeInfo: Hurricane refuge areas are a last resort for people without a safer place. They have no supplies, so bring your kit. If your home was built in 1995 or later and is outside flood and storm surge areas, staying home may be safer.
safety.tsunamiNotRefuge: For a tsunami, don't head to a refuge area. Go inland or to high ground, out of the evacuation zone.

location.heading: Your location
location.denied: Location access is turned off. You can enter coordinates instead.
location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. You can enter coordinates instead.
location.unsupported: This device can't share its location. You can enter coordinates instead.
location.invalid: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.

data.error: Couldn't load map data. Connect once to download it.
data.sampleBody: This list is made up for demonstration. Do not use it to make safety decisions.

alerts.offlineCached: Couldn't reach the National Weather Service. You're seeing the last saved copy.
alerts.neverLoaded: No alerts saved yet. Connect to the internet once to load them.
alerts.none: No active alerts for Hawaiʻi as of {{time}}.
alerts.englishOnly: Alert text comes from the National Weather Service in English.

plan.privacy: Your plan is saved only on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
plan.saveFailed: Couldn't save on this device. Your browser may be blocking storage (for example, in private browsing).
plan.meetBody: Pick places everyone knows, in case you get separated and phones are down.

meetPlaceholder.nearHome: e.g. the mailbox by the corner
meetPlaceholder.outsideNeighborhood: e.g. the library on School Street
meetPlaceholder.highGround: e.g. the park up the hill

plan.contactsBody: Include someone off-island. Long-distance calls and texts often work when local lines are busy.
plan.notesPlaceholder: Medical needs, medications, where the kit is kept…
plan.qrPrivacy: This QR code contains the names, phone numbers, and places above. Only share it with your household.
plan.qrAlt: QR code with your meeting places and emergency contacts
plan.qrTooBig: Your plan is too long to fit in a QR code. Use Print instead, or shorten the notes.

map.label: Map of evacuation zones. Tap a spot to check it.
map.unavailable: The map can't be shown on this device. You can still use your location or enter coordinates.
map.help: Tap the map to check a spot. Use two fingers to move the map. Can't use the map? Use your location or enter coordinates below. The map covers Oʻahu; zones cover all main islands.
